He was also known for his many narration roles, most notably in the "Super Sentai" series. He was a very influential figure in the dubbing industry during the Sousei period. After graduating from Tokyo Metropolitan University Jōnan Senior High School (in which he was also the supervisor of the school's volleyball team), he went on to graduate from the Meiji University Department of Political Science and Economics.
